description: This file defines the JwtInvalidException class, a custom exception used in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.jwt package to represent invalid JWT token errors. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON and setting headers, along with a nested builder class.

classes.name: JwtInvalidException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an invalid JWT token, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing JwtException.

classes.name: JwtInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing JwtInvalidException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Builder instance for JwtInvalidException.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a JwtInvalidException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new JwtInvalidException with updated headers.
